name: Pokémon TCG API
tagline: Complete Pokémon Trading Card Game card database with sets, prices, and images
description: Public REST API providing comprehensive Pokémon TCG card data including card details, sets, rarities, images, and market prices. Free developer API key with rate-limited access for building deck builders, collectors tools, price trackers, and TCG apps.

auth.details: API key via X-Api-Key header; free self-serve signup at dev.pokemontcg.io. Key optional for very low rates but required for higher limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free API key required for higher limits; unauthenticated access is heavily rate-limited

rate_limits: Without API key: 1,000 req/day (max ~30 req/min); with free API key: 20,000 req/day. Higher limits available by contacting the maintainer.
use_cases: search Pokémon TCG cards by name or type
list all cards in a specific set
get card images for a deck builder
look up market prices for a card
browse available TCG sets and expansions
